name: brisas-pos
description: Sistema de punto de venta para el restaurante Mirador Brisas del Monte (Costa Rica). Corre 100% en la LAN del restaurante.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @brisas/backend" "npm run dev -w @brisas/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @brisas/shared && npm run build -w @brisas/backend && npm run build -w @brisas/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @brisas/shared && npm run test -w @brisas/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @brisas/shared && npm run db:seed -w @brisas/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @brisas/shared && npm run typecheck -w @brisas/backend && npm run typecheck -w @brisas/frontend
